.
The flood warning issued for the Kelani River Basin under my reference number DI/Hydro/103(V) and
Flood Warning Bulletin No. 03, released on 2025.11.28 at 1:00 p.m., is hereby extended for a further
48 hours. Therefore, residents living in the affected areas are kindly requested to remain highly alert
and take necessary measures to ensure their safety in the event of possible flood conditions. The relevant
disaster management authorities are also requested to take the necessary actions accordingly.
